Joint functional mixed effects with nested trial B-spline random functions

etr_fit_joint_bspline_functional_nested_trial.Rd

Fits a native Gaussian joint functional mixed-effects regression with separate unstructured participant-level and nested-trial-level B-spline random-function covariances, optionally with serial correlation confined to each trial. Requires nlme. Each participant-trial pair must identify exactly one curve. This is a bounded scientific analogue, not full Python 1.2 source-contract parity.

Usage

etr_fit_joint_bspline_functional_nested_trial(
  trajectories, design, predictors, participant_column, trial_column, dimension,
  residual_correlation = "iid", fixed_basis_size = 6L,
  random_basis_size = 4L, trial_random_basis_size = 3L,
  spline_degree = 3L, reml = TRUE, maxiter = 500L
)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete finite common-grid native trajectory set.

design

Data frame containing one row per curve and a unique curve_id.

predictors

Character vector of numeric fixed predictors; may be empty.

participant_column

Participant grouping column in trajectory metadata.

trial_column

Distinct within-participant trial identifier in metadata.

dimension

One response channel name.

residual_correlation

"iid", "ar1" on a regular grid, or "exponential" using time distances.

fixed_basis_size

Positive integer number of fixed spline functions.

random_basis_size

Positive integer participant random basis size.

trial_random_basis_size

Positive integer nested trial random basis size.

spline_degree

Spline degree, 1 through 5.

reml

Fit by restricted maximum likelihood if TRUE, ML otherwise.

maxiter

Maximum optimizer iterations, at least 10.

Value

Also includes Python-shaped coefficient, participant/trial covariance, residual-correlation, conditional residual-whitening, and nested trial ID fields; the original native names remain available. The source optimizer bounds are diagnostic only and are not enforced by the native optimizer. The result also includes residual-correlation eigenvalues, condition number, source optimizer-bound diagnostics, grid regularity and interval, conditional whitened residual functions, and source-style trial ID aliases. These are diagnostic/representation additions, not revised fits. The returned object also includes source-aligned covariance eigenvalues, condition numbers, near-boundary and singularity flags for both random levels. An etr_joint_bspline_mixed_nested_trial S3 object inheriting etr_joint_bspline_mixed. Includes fitted and residual trajectories, fixed coefficient functions and standard errors, random-function BLUPs, participant and trial coefficient covariances, residual covariance parameters, and the fitted nlme::lme model.
